name: BrauKunstHaus Zillertal Bier Zell
kurzbeschreibung: The BrauKunstHaus in Zell am Ziller: Tyrol's most modern beer experience world spanning over 5,000 m² with brewing art, Tyrolean cultural history, and tasting.
beschreibung:
Overview

The BrauKunstHaus Zillertal Bier in Zell am Ziller offers a fascinating experience for all senses and provides deep insights into the world of brewing beer. As Tyrol's oldest private brewery, Zillertal Bier has combined traditional craftsmanship with state-of-the-art technology for generations. Visitors delve into the history of beer, learn interesting facts about the raw materials and the brewing process, and can feel the passion that goes into every drop. It is a place that delights both beer lovers and families, making the culture of the Ziller Valley uniquely tangible.

Route & Requirements

The BrauKunstHaus is barrier-free, making it suitable for all age groups and physical conditions. The interactive exhibition guides visitors on a well-signposted tour through various thematic areas, from the history of the brewery to the individual steps of beer production. No special physical requirements are needed, allowing for a relaxed and enjoyable visit. The duration of the tour can be flexibly adjusted to individual interests, with approximately 1.5 to 2 hours recommended for a comprehensive experience.

Visit & Arrival

The BrauKunstHaus Zillertal Bier is centrally located in Zell am Ziller and is easily accessible by both car and public transport. Ample parking is available directly on site. The Zillertalbahn also stops in the immediate vicinity, allowing for convenient travel without a private vehicle. We recommend booking in advance, especially for groups or during peak season, to avoid waiting times and ensure a smooth experience. Opening hours vary seasonally, so checking the official website is advisable.

Tips

After an exciting tour through the BrauKunstHaus, you should definitely take the opportunity to visit the in-house restaurant “Bräustüberl”. There, you can expect traditional Zillertal specialties, perfectly paired with the brewery's diverse beer selection. A tasting of the various Zillertal beers is an absolute must to discover the quality and variety of the products. In the adjoining shop, you will also find a wide selection of beers, regional products, and souvenirs, ideal as a memento or gift for friends and family.
preis: Tour incl. tasting adults approx. €12.50, children approx. €6.00
oeffnungszeiten: Year-round Mon–Sat 10:00 AM–6:00 PM (Sun closed; last entry 4:30 PM)
